grounding.excerpt: The permittee is required to submit a detailed plan to test for Delta-BHC at the source water
shall become effective on January 1, 2022. This permit and the authorization to discharge shall expire at midnight, December 31, 2026.

payload.rationale: The operative permit clause requires submission of a detailed plan to test for Delta-BHC at source water intake, not effluent monitoring against a numeric discharge concentration in routine DMRs. That positive permit language establishes a source-water study/planning obligation rather than a routine FY2025 DMR numeric discharge limit. The permit term covers FY2025, so the cited requirement is in force for the evaluation window. Therefore DMR absence of Delta-BHC is not, by itself, evidence of a discharge-limit exceedance.
